title: Nomino (Theme 1: Nyumbani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child asks "is it the name of a person, animal, place or thing?" before calling a word a noun.
representations: a sentence with each word on a card
a sorting chart: nomino / si nomino
steps: For each word ask: is it a name?
Check it is not an action or a describing word.

board.do: Point at each word in turn.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child circles the three nouns and says what each names.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mama ananunua ___ sokoni." Kwa nini "anapika" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino ni jina la mtu, mnyama, mahali au kitu. "Anapika" ni kitenzi, kinaonyesha kitendo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni neno lipi ni nomino?" Kwa nini "kubwa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino ni jina la kitu chenyewe. "Kubwa" ni kivumishi, kinaeleza kitu kikoje.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni neno lipi ni nomino?" Kwa nini "haraka" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: "Haraka" na "jana" ni vielezi: vinaonyesha jinsi au wakati. Nomino hutaja mtu, mnyama, mahali au kitu.

misconceptions.ask: Neno hili ni jina la mtu au ni neno linalosimama badala ya jina?
misconceptions.repair: Yeye ni kiwakilishi: kinasimama badala ya jina. Nomino ni jina: mtoto, chakula.

checks.question: Ni nomino ipi: kimbia, ndizi, haraka?
Taja nomino katika sentensi: "Juma ana kalamu."
